title: Budget Meals As a Proportion of All Meals Sold Hawker Stalls
what_it_is: Budget Meals As a Proportion of All Meals Sold Hawker Stalls

sections.label: Hawker budget meals and costs
sections.summary: Minister says affordable meal options remain at hawker centres, NEA does not regulate food prices, and rental rebates help sustain budget meals.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment in light of the continued rise in food prices at hawker centres (a) what proportion of meals sold at a hawker stall are budget meals; and (b) whether there has been feedback from hawkers that the budget meals are increasingly difficult to sustain.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Thus far, despite rising costs, affordable meal options remain available at our hawker centres, including those managed by NEA and Town Councils, as well as socially conscious enterprises, where the operators are required to keep food affordable and have done so by ensuring at least one budget meal option per stall.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
sentences.text: The budget meals are much appreciated, but we are starting to see quite a big divergence between the budget meals and the regular price meals; and also starting to see a creep in the lower price options, say from a $3.80-budget meal has become a $4.20-budget meal in one of my coffee shops.

sentences.speaker: Ms Mariam Jaafar (Sembawang)
sentences.text: So, I understand that currently they have a rental rebate of 5% to sustain these budget meals and that is for a year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: As I said, NEA does not regulate food prices sold at hawker centres because hawkers face different cost pressures in running their operations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Some of these factors can include the operating costs, perhaps utilities, it could also pertain to some of the other cost that they incur from buying their raw materials, for example.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But as she has mentioned, NEA does provide some help in terms of moderating their rentals and in times of need, there has been some rent rebates given to these hawkers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We will watch these pressures on our hawkers closely and if there are further needs, we can see how we can best assist them.

sections.label: Assurance Packages and CDC vouchers
sections.summary: Cost-of-living Assurance Packages and CDC vouchers give residents cash to spend at hawker centres and bring hawkers revenue.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Other options that can help defray the costs to consumers, for example, would come in the form of our cost-of-living Assurance Packages, including Community Development Council vouchers, that help our residents to have some extra cash to spend at these hawker centres and also bring some revenue benefit to these hawkers as well.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, I think, through these kind of efforts in a multi-pronged manner, we hope to reduce the cost impact on consumers while helping our hawkers to remain sustainable.
